1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto perenne de hasta 3 m de altura, con hojas bipinnadas, flores blancas fragantes y fruto en vaina. (Fabaceae, Calliandra portoricensis).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial shrub reaching up to 3 m in height, with bipinnate leaves, fragrant white flowers and fruit in a pod (Fabaceae, Calliandra portoricensis).
